description: Progressive as defined by Miriam-Webster is of or relating to progress: such as using, involving, or interested in new or modern ideas characterized by continuous improvement or advancement. title: What It Means to Be Progressive — and Why Moving Forward Matters – Thomas Monks 4 North Carlona
